---
title: "Brief Description"
---
I am a quantitative researcher with 7+ years of experience in agricultural commodities, combining market fundamentals with data science. At ECOM Trading I worked across cocoa, coffee and cotton, building forecasting models, trading signals, weather analytics and satellite-based crop models that fed directly into trading decisions.

My background pairs deep technical skill (Python, R, machine learning, time-series forecasting and geospatial analysis) with a scientific training in plant sciences, which gives me a practical understanding of how weather and crop biology drive supply.

I have led data science teams, mentored junior colleagues, and trained staff at major banks and retailers. I care about turning complex analysis into clear, actionable views for decision-makers.

**Next step:** since late 2024 my focus has been commodities analysis in agricultural markets.
